1.mascotDialogue: Pivot don't move again after partitioning — already home. Everything left to sort strictly smaller one side, strictly bigger other side.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 9 place pivot at her final resting index. Lines 16 and 17 recurse on strictly-smaller and strictly-bigger side — pivot herself never touched again.

3.mascotDialogue: This pivot happen to be smallest value, so end up all the way at index 0 — unlucky pivot choice, and good example why selection matter for performance.

4.mascotDialogue: One character out of place — p instead of p minus one — and recursion lose her most important guarantee: every recursive call must work on strictly smaller range than one before.
